name: ASP Isotopes Inc.
summary: ASP Isotopes Inc., a development stage advanced materials company, engages in the production, distribution, marketing, and sale of isotopes in South Africa,Hong Kong, and United States. It operates in two segments, Nuclear Fuels, and Specialist Isotopes and Related Services. The Nuclear Fuels segment focuses on the research and development of technologies and methods used to produce high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) and Lithium-6 for the advanced nuclear fuels target end market.
